Return to Nucleus once a week for 6 weeks and repeat the core action above, using the same wallet address every time so the activity builds one visible history. Cost: no extra capital, only gas of about $2 to $8 per visit. Time: 6 weeks, about 10 minutes per visit.

Use the protocol's own app on Plume Mainnet, Ethereum, Arbitrum and 1 more rather than a third-party front end, and if it runs a points or quests program, complete the weekly tasks it lists with the same address. Cost: free apart from gas. Time: 10 minutes per week.
The radar puts graduation one to two years out, so pace the activity below across 6 weeks and revisit the position monthly. Cost: the $75 position plus gas. Time: 45 days of activity.

Keep a record of every deposit, transaction hash and date for Nucleus in a notebook, and set a calendar reminder to check for a token or points announcement once a week. Cost: free. Time: 5 minutes per week.

Do not chase the position with more capital if the protocol's TVL falls two weeks in a row; unwind by withdrawing the $75 stake and leaving only a dust position, and never pay anyone who promises to boost your allocation. Cost: one withdrawal transaction, about $2 to $8 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to unwind.
